title_zh: 典型倒Y形桥结构分析刚度法研究
title_en: Stiffness Method Study of Structural Analysis of Typical Inverted Y-Shape Bridge
authors: Haiyun Huang
primary_category: 脑电基础模型与通用解码
abstract_zh: 在一般基本梁理论的基础上，根据增加自由度的分析方法，提出了用于薄壁箱梁分析的每节点10自由度的有限元。以典型的倒Y形薄壁箱梁桥为研究对象，分别建立了一般空间梁格模型、空间板壳有限元分析模型和有机玻璃试验模型，并根据不同理论对模型的各种分析和测量进行了比较。研究结果验证了表明本文提出的理论分析方法正确、简单。
abstract_en: The finite element with 10 degrees of freedom each node for analysis of thin-wall box girder is proposed according to the analysis method of increasing degrees of freedom on the basis of the general elementary beam theory.By taking a typical inverted Y-shape thin-wall box girder bridge as the research object,the general spatial beam grillage model,spatial plate and shell finite element analysis model and organic glass test model are respectively set up,and various analysis and measurements of the models are compared according to the different theories.The results of study verify that the theoretic analysis method proposed in the paper is correct and simple.

title_zh: 基于格架理论的Y型桥结构分析
title_en: Structure analysis for Y-shape Bridge based on grillage theory
authors: Haiyun Huang
primary_category: 脑电基础模型与通用解码
abstract_zh: 本文对高架桥或高架桥工程中Y型桥的结构计算进行了简化，同时基于有限元程序软件对板梁模态进行了仿真分析，这是求解和求解Y型桥复杂内力的一种有效途径。对结构进行了理论分析，提出了如何处理格架划分和断面特征参数等值得注意的问题。
abstract_en: In this paper simplification of structure calculation of Y-shape Bridge in the project of viaduct bridge or overhead crossing is carried out,and at the same time the simulation analysis of grillage mode is also carried out based on procedure software of finite element.It is a kind of effective way for asking and solving the complicated internal force of Y-shape bridge.By means of practice calculation,and at the same time,comparing with shell mode,the result of analysis indicates that they are of better value in the practice engineering application.In addition,while the grillage theory is carried out for structure analysis,some problems of worth notice are put forward about how to deal with the grillage divide and sectional characteristic parameter,then some existent problems and content of structure analysis are studied.

title_zh: 用于光传输系统的 10Gb/s CMOS 限幅放大器
title_en: 10Gb/s CMOS Limiting Amplifier for Optical Transmission Systems
venue: IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
authors: Haiyun Huang；Wen Jincai；Lingling Sun
primary_category: 脑电基础模型与通用解码
topics: 智能芯片与计算系统
abstract_zh: 用于光纤传输系统的10 Gb/s限幅放大器采用0.18 /spl mu/m CMOS技术实现，整个电路由输入缓冲器网络、四个增益单元和用于驱动50 /spl Omega/传输线的输出缓冲器和用于偏移消除的偏移补偿组成。该限幅放大器允许输入动态范围为 32 dB (20mV-800 mV)，并提供恒定的输出电压摆幅 (800 mV/sub pp/)，电源电压为 3.3 V 时功耗为 99 mW，芯片面积为 0.8/spl times/1.3 mm/sup 2/。
abstract_en: A 10 Gb/s limiting amplifier for fiber-optic transmission system is realized in a 0.18 /spl mu/m CMOS technology, the whole circuit consists of an input-buffer network, four gain cells, and a output buffer for driving 50 /spl Omega/ transmission lines and offset compensation for offset cancellation. This limiting amplifier allows an input dynamic is rang of 32 dB (20mV-800 mV) and provides a constant output voltage swing (800 mV/sub pp/), the power dissipation is 99 mW with the supply voltage of 3.3 V, the chip area is 0.8/spl times/1.3 mm/sup 2/.

title_zh: 用于从体积图像恢复股骨形状的 3D 可变形模型
title_en: 3-D deformable models for femur shape recovery from volumetric images
venue: International Conference on High Performance Computing in Asia-Pacific Region (HPC Asia)
authors: Xuechun Zhao；Feihu Qi；Haiyun Huang；Jinfeng Zhan
primary_category: 脑电基础模型与通用解码
topics: 医学影像与脑疾病诊断
abstract_zh: 提出了一种使用可变形模型从体积图像恢复股骨形状的新方案。首先，使用点分布模型技术将先前的 3D 可变形股骨模型创建为模板。其次，采用主动轮廓模型对胫骨和股骨关节的磁共振成像（MRI）体积图像进行分割，并根据分割结果初始化可变形模型。最后，最小化目标函数以给出约束形状表面的最佳结果。
abstract_en: A new scheme for femur shape recovery from volumetric images using deformable models was proposed. First, prior 3D deformable femur models are created as templates using point distribution models technology. Second, active contour models are employed to segment the magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) volumetric images of the tibial and femoral joint and the deformable models are initialized based on the segmentation results. Finally, the objective function is minimized to give the optimal results constraining the surface of shapes.
